profile_text.body:
Dynatrace, Inc. is a public company headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts, trading under the ticker DT. Its website describes the company as an observability platform built for the age of AI, offering observability, AI, automation, and application security in one platform. The site calls Dynatrace the AI-powered observability leader and says the platform turns data into decisions and autonomous actions.

The company's site quotes Stephen Elliot, Group Vice President at IDC, as saying the future of observability is preventive and autonomous, using deterministic AI and AI agents to coordinate actions across cloud platforms, developer tools, and IT service management. A customer statement on the site says Dynatrace's AI engine provides early detection of potential system issues without false alarms, reducing the time required to identify root causes from hours to minutes. The available material does not name specific product lines.

SEC records identify Dynatrace, Inc. as a for-profit public company with CIK 0001773383. It also appears under the names Dynatrace, Inc. and DYNATRACE INC. Massachusetts records show 191 law exposure entries associated with Dynatrace, Inc. No specific litigation cases or MCP servers are named in the available data.
